description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=768471), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6092961)

Suddenly, a truck flies into the peaceful(?) classroom, and in an instant, the children in the class are teleported to another world. 

The friends lose their lives one by one to the suddenly appearing monsters, and the only one who can save them from this crisis is the creator of the novel, Deok-gu.  
 
"The moment you tear the note, it becomes reality."
